hook_stat.sub: Fee on new H-1B petitions, already blocked by two court injunctions

news_summary: Employers and workers in Global Nurse Force v. Trump have asked a California federal court to move quickly toward summary judgment on the $100,000 H-1B fee, while the Trump administration wants the case paused until the Ninth Circuit decides its appeal.
payoff: Petitions are being processed without the fee for now, but the relief rests on preliminary orders an appeals court could undo.
